meta.name: llm-wiki
meta.description: Build and maintain a structured LLM-generated wiki for any codebase. Use when the user asks to analyze/understand/document a codebase, build a code wiki, create project documentation from source, or update an existing .llm-wiki. Triggers on phrases like "build wiki", "analyze this codebase", "document this project", "update wiki", "llm-wiki", or when entering an unfamiliar project that has no .llm-wiki yet.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为任意代码库自动生成并维护结构化维基文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解或记录不熟悉的代码库
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate and maintain structured wiki docs for any codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand or document unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为你的代码项目自动创建和维护一个结构化的维基百科，包含架构、模块、API 等文档，并持续更新。
howto.when: 当你要求分析、理解或记录代码库，或说出“构建维基”、“分析代码库”、“更新维基”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 为这个项目构建一个维基。
say.note: Claude 会扫描代码并生成 .llm-wiki/ 目录。

say.text: 更新现有维基，反映最近的代码变更。
say.note: Claude 会检测差异并刷新相关文章。

say.text: 分析这个代码库的架构。
say.note: Claude 会生成架构概览和模块文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically create and maintain a structured wiki for your code project, covering architecture, modules, APIs, and more, and keep it updated.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze, understand, or document a codebase, or say phrases like "build wiki", "analyze this codebase", "update wiki".

say_en.text: Build a wiki for this project.
say_en.note: Claude scans the code and generates the .llm-wiki/ directory.

say_en.text: Update the existing wiki to reflect recent code changes.
say_en.note: Claude detects diffs and refreshes relevant articles.

say_en.text: Analyze the architecture of this codebase.
say_en.note: Claude generates architecture overview and module docs.
